observer.accounting_basis: Recognized revenue plus recovery income minus incurred expenses; signed revisions retained. Seed and principal reserve releases are not profit. Payables remain incurred expenses even when unpaid. Taxes enter only when recorded as native expense; no added hypothetical tax/depreciation.

interval.boundary: [start,end); all same-hour actions included or excluded together

limits: Requires independent native and operating audits of the source result.
Existing modeled cost coverage and unknown host/model billing are unchanged.
No annualization, pooled enterprises, forward inference, or spending authority.
Post-operating settlement drain remains on the account but is excluded from this operating-window measure.
